title: Using an LLM to Tackle Difficult Cases in NER for Nepali Tweets
abstract: arXiv:2611.08967v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is challenging for social media data in a low-resource language. LLMs often lag behind pretrained language models (PLMs) in NER performance, but they show promise in handling cases that PLMs struggle with. Using a dataset of Nepali tweets, we split the test set into "easy" and "hard" cases using token probabilities from a fine-tuned pretrained language model (PLM). We then evaluate an LLM on the hard test cases using 16 different prompt configurations. We find that selecting examples based on semantic similarity and increasing the number of examples improves F1 score by almost 10 points from the baseline configuration. Although the LLM underperforms the PLM on the full and easy test sets, it surpasses the PLM on the hard test set, resulting in an improved score when the two models are combined.

translated_title: 使用大语言模型解决尼泊尔语推文命名实体识别中的困难案例
translated_abstract: 命名实体识别（NER）对于低资源语言的社交媒体数据来说是一项挑战。大语言模型（LLM）在NER性能上通常落后于预训练语言模型（PLM），但在处理PLM难以应对的案例方面展现出潜力。我们使用一个尼泊尔语推文数据集，利用微调后的预训练语言模型（PLM）的词元概率将测试集划分为“简单”和“困难”两类案例。随后，我们使用16种不同的提示配置在困难测试案例上对大语言模型进行评估。我们发现，基于语义相似度选择示例并增加示例数量，可使F1分数比基线配置提高近10分。尽管大语言模型在完整测试集和简单测试集上表现不如PLM，但它在困难测试集上超越了PLM，两个模型结合后取得了更高的分数。
tldr: 本研究利用微调PLM的词元概率将测试集划分为简单与困难案例，并通过基于语义相似度选择示例的提示策略使LLM在困难NER案例上超越PLM，两模型结合后获得更优的整体性能。
en_tdlr: By splitting test cases into easy and hard subsets using a fine-tuned PLM's token probabilities and prompting an LLM with semantically similar examples, the LLM outperforms the PLM on hard NER cases, and combining both models yields improved overall performance.
